visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: One Generic Box Instead of Two Copies
visualizerParams.problemDescription: StringBox and IntBox are the same class with a different field type. Replace them with one generic Box<T>. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Generics remove the copy-and-paste: one class works for every type, and the compiler still checks each use. Add a method once and every Box gets it.
